*** Add File: /home/ugur/harve-y/tacto-negotiator/docs/v2/implementation-order-addendum-2026-10-10.md
+# V2 capability delivery: proposed implementation-order addendum
+
+10 October 2026. Assessment of checkout `a88bf86` **including the existing working-tree
+planning/test changes**. This is a proposal, not an approved contract revision or a completion
+claim. No production code, tests, fixtures, or existing planning documents were changed for
+this assessment. Task IDs, architecture, and C's implemented-type contracts remain authoritative.
+
+The smallest useful adjustment is to **implement contracts beside their first consumers,
+and bring real evidence resolution, economics, validation, and behavioral evaluation forward**.
+Do not wait for all D1–D16 to start component work. Do not promise that the complete existing
+pipeline can use only a handful of DTOs: its current public input and result types have a
+substantial transitive dependency closure.
+
+## A. Actual state and architectural assessment
+
+| Area | Inspected implementation state | Implication |
+|---|---|---|
+| T1.1a | Frozen values/terms, strict parsing, canonical serialization/hashes, errors implemented | Reuse unchanged |
+| T1.1b | Assessment models and exact Protocol declarations implemented | Reuse; declarations referencing absent DTOs do not make the ports executable end to end |
+| T1.1c | DecisionStage/DecisionRecord/EffectiveConfig and config resolver implemented | T1.3 composition and T1.4 record persistence remain unfinished |
+| T1.1d | EvidenceScope, Provenance, TemporalValidity, DisclosureRule implemented | All 160 remaining declared exports are absent: 146 concrete DTOs plus 14 unions |
+| T1.2a/b | No recorded adapter, factory, or orchestration loop | Normalizer, scripted fakes, and sentinel routing test are preparation |
+| T2–T6 | No concrete V2 evidence, interpreter, economics, strategy, execution, store, or evaluation components | Planned tests and V1 implementations are reuse material, not delivered V2 capabilities |
+| V1 | Existing negotiator, arithmetic integrations, adviser, evidence, runtime, Lab infrastructure | Preserve named historical baseline; wrap useful primitives rather than assume current callers are safe |
+
+Fresh local verification in this pass:
+
+- `tests/v2`: **380 passed, 796 xfailed**, no unexpected failures. Many passes validate
+  specification examples; the 796 explicit missing-component/DTO xfails are not completed work.
+- Ruff over `src/negotiator/v2 tests/v2`: passes.
+- Frozen V1 replay: exact historical first move matches `3653046`; no network/model calls.
+- Six focused legacy modules from A's verification recipe: **56 passed, 4 failed**.
+  Failures remain the inverse-price regression, two final-offer history/memory expectations,
+  and empty-thread mocked-agent compatibility (`test_evaluator.py` and `test_context.py`).
+  This is a bounded check, not a full repository readiness claim.
+
+Preserve evidence / interpretation / strategy / economics / validation / execution /
+orchestration boundaries, dependency injection, strict contracts, deterministic finances,
+independent validation, source applicability/provenance, reproducible records, and the pinned
+official kit. Keep the existing serial coordinator and SQLite direction. Preserve V1 goldens
+and audit obligations in A §4. The source inspected still contains the legacy inverse helper,
+separate cost access, and mutable runtime paths; none becomes safe through this proposal.
+
+The avoidable dependencies are **whole-task barriers**: T1.2a, T1.4, T2.1, and T4.1 name
+all of T1.1d; the instructions require the exact serial D1–D16 order; T6.1 waits for M5.
+T5.1 also waits for all of T2.3 even for an offer with no factual claims. These are broader
+than their first consumers need. Preserve real prerequisites: constructors need their field
+types and complete union members; economic joins need verified basis/standards; grounding needs
+actual source/message references; sending needs validation and durable ownership.
+
+## B. Minimal roadmap delta and critical path
+
+Keep M0–M7 and T identifiers. A–E below are **capability checkpoints across existing tasks**,
+not replacement milestone IDs. A partial parent remains in progress until all its original
+acceptance criteria pass. Keep shared-model edits serial; a new component may follow each
+dependency-complete contract handoff rather than waiting for all batches.
+
+| Checkpoint | Required work and order using existing IDs | Exit gate / status |
+|---|---|---|
+| A: functional backbone | T1.1d types on demand; T1.2a P10 binding; T1.3 offline composition; T1.4 artifact/record append/reload; T1.2b complete typed loop. Bring T4.1 official package evaluation and the used offer/question subset of T5.1 forward. Context, interpretation, strategy, generation and feedback may initially be recorded ports | Actual ten-stage loop, deterministic costs, independent used-action checks, fake execution and feedback, saved/reloaded trace. **Required next, not implemented; scripted intelligence explicitly labelled** |
+| B: evidence-driven intelligence | Start T2.1 now; replace A's mock context with resolver-backed context. T3.1 labels + T6.1 local behavioral controls start now. Add T3.2 bounded deterministic interpretation/fallback and grounded draft validation, T4.2 finite generation, T4.3 evidence-conditioned proposal and deterministic selector. Add needed T2.3 standards/estimate projections; add T2.2 preparation when reading real package data | Relevant evidence/reply changes alter defensible intent and, when affordable/legal, selected action; irrelevant wording does not. Actual interpretation/strategy algorithms, evaluator and validator run. **Required next after/alongside backbone** |
+| C: reliable execution | Complete used-scope T2.2/2.3 and T5.1; T5.2 projector + atomic state/operation/claim transaction; T5.3 endpoint gateway/executor/recovery; T5.4 serial multi-turn loop and basic feedback. Add minimum T3.3 budget plumbing if using a model. T6.2 only for the intended CLI/Lab launch path | Local simulator plus crash/uncertain-outcome/restart gates before any real execution. Live readiness remains separate from local proof and needs operational authorization. **Required later** |
+| D: experimental framework | Register baseline and evidence-conditioned bundles through existing T1.3/T4.3 seams; extend T6.1 to identical recorded situations. Add T4.4 bounded LLM selector and T3.3/3.4 interpretation/provider evaluations when chosen and funded; T6.3/6.4 retain performance/promotion gates | Same evidence/economic/validation services, distinct strategy/config identities, held-out reports. Basic substitutability checked already in A/B. **Required later; model selector optional** |
+| E: advanced capabilities | Retain T2.4 broader documents, T4.5 generic solver, T7.1–7.5 category/information-value/async/research/basket expansion and F's research queue. Sophisticated memory, preference estimation and attribution algorithms remain here | Enable on concrete requirement or measured gap. **Deferred; optional experiments remain optional** |
+
+Shortest credible paths, with no full-parent completion hidden in these arrows:
+
+1. **Offline loop:** dependency-complete T1.1d groups → P10-only T1.2a → T1.3
+   composition + T1.4 append/load → T1.2b with real T4.1 and a real T5.1 used-action
+   subset → checkpoint A. Storage is append-only decision/artifact storage at this stage;
+   do not require the full live StateStore implementation to replay a decision.
+2. **Evidence-sensitive decision:** T2.1 resolver/context + T3.1/T6.1 controls → T3.2
+   bounded real interpretation → T4.2/T4.3 + necessary T2.3 projections → run through A's
+   economic/validation pipeline → checkpoint B. The first bounded interpreter may safely
+   recognize structured offers and explicit supported signals, preserving exact citations and
+   unknowns. It must derive outputs from current inputs, not select prewritten assessments by
+   fixture ID. Broader language coverage uses the same port and later evaluated model adapter.
+3. **Reliable real execution:** B + strict data preflight/relationship estimates → full
+   used-scope T5.1 → T5.2 → T5.3 → T5.4, intended launch-path checks and runtime fault matrix
+   → checkpoint C. No model is required for a deterministic baseline. If enabled, its absolute
+   budget/cancellation/fallback gates are prerequisites to transmitting.
+
+Do not let A become another long framework project. Replace each scripted decision component
+as its types become available; use T2.1 and T4.1 direct component demonstrations before A is
+complete. Basic feedback is observed linkage, not learned causal attribution. Persist operation
+identity/provenance before real sending; an unknown outcome retains its original ID/bytes and
+blocks a conflicting action. All closing paths still need fresh standing-sheet checks and the
+same deterministic close evaluator. Supplier prose never establishes terminal truth.
+
+## C. DTO classification and limits of deferral
+
+The existing layout can stay. Public cross-module contracts include evidence/context,
+assessment, intent/candidate/evaluation/decision, validated action, operation, and result
+envelopes. Nested contract helpers such as term origins and cost components also remain
+explicit. Provider projection DTOs belong at the adapter boundary; hydrated events belong at
+the store/projector boundary. They are not all necessary to *algorithm development*, but
+their present contract placement is not a reason to migrate packages.
+
+Private ranking scores, search queues, parser working structures, caches, and strategy-specific
+reasoning can remain internal typed models. Do not add them to core speculatively. Existing
+StrategyMemory supports owned payload schemas by reference; defer its algorithm, not its
+referenced shape if NegotiationState already requires it. Empty tuples or disabled estimates
+do not remove the need to define the complete declared type/union.
+
+Static closure check: start with PreparedEvidence, DecisionSnapshot, IntentBatch,
+GenerationResult, EvaluationBatch, NegotiationDecision, RenderedAction, ValidationResult,
+PendingOperation, DispatchPermit, TransportBudget, ExecutionResult, EventProposal, ReplayResult,
+VerifiedClaim and OfficialCostResult. Recursively follow field type names and every union member
+in `tests/v2/dto-contracts.json`. This reaches **128 of 160 remaining exports** (DTOs and
+unions), before any model/gateway envelopes. Adding ModelRequest, ModelBudget, ModelResult,
+GatewayResult and ServerObservation for the existing integration seams reaches **148 of 160**.
+These are schema dependency counts, not proof that a codec/test cutline needs exactly that
+many; full port introspection and optional scenario bindings may require more. Record the
+chosen consumer roots and exact symbol set before assigning each integration handoff.
+
+| Batch | First-loop classification under the existing model/gateway seams | Safety / later / optional distinction |
+|---|---|---|
+| D1 | All 8 fact payloads via EvidencePayload | Preserve closed union even if first fixture only uses CostFact/TextRecord |
+| D2 | 11/12 including evidence records, preparation, conflicts, context | ResolvedCostInput joins needed with T2.3; integrity/applicability never deferred when consuming evidence |
+| D3 | All 13 case/buyer/terms/alternative exports | Essential correctness; unavailable alternative cannot become zero/infinity |
+| D4 | All 11 economics/policy/evaluation exports | Essential economics. Scenario shapes required; scenario estimation/robust algorithms can follow. Live relationship-sensitive use needs estimates or documented admitted degraded scope |
+| D5 | All 11 intent/candidate/batch/decision exports | Stable strategy/economic boundary, including complete CandidateContents union |
+| D6 | All 10 message/server/clock/round/terminal exports | Essential input shapes. Authoritative terminal, deadline and round proof is live safety, not permission to infer it offline |
+| D7 | 7/11: ClaimWindow, VerifiedClaim and closing result shapes | ClaimCandidate/results/verification union needed when enabling factual claims and full T5.1; closing shapes arrive through ReplayResult even before close algorithms |
+| D8–D9 | All rendering, validation, budgets, operation and permit exports | Essential used-action boundary; durable commit/permit issuance is checkpoint C behavior |
+| D10–D11 | All state/context/outcome exports | Required by existing signatures; advanced memory/attribution behavior deferred despite available schemas |
+| D12–D13 | 10/11 each for existing model/gateway seams | DocumentBytes later with document fetch; SelectorResponse optional T4.4. Without those gateway seams, both groups can follow the first mock-port loop, but existing model-variability acceptance remains outstanding |
+| D14 | All 8 via EventPayload | Shapes required by FeedbackProcessor's EventProposal; event-store transitions completed at C |
+| D15 | 9/14 via EventProposal/EventPayload | NegotiationEvent, DecisionCommit, CommittedResult, ConflictResult, CommitResult required for C's atomic store; no live dispatch before them |
+| D16 | All 5 result exports | Stable replay/execution boundary; acknowledgement is not a deal or terminal proof |
+
+This explains the DTO bottleneck honestly: EvidenceRecord pulls in all evidence payloads;
+NegotiationState pulls in strategic history helpers; EventProposal pulls in all hydrated event
+variants; ReplayResult pulls in closing types. **Do not narrow those unions or redefine public
+ports to chase a smaller count.** Most savings come from earlier component work and deferred
+algorithms, not from removing schema definitions. C's immutable field/invariant definitions
+remain binding whenever a type is implemented.
+
+## D. Early behavioral acceptance and honest gates
+
+T6.1 local behavior work starts with T3.1, rather than after M5. Keep the present preference
+flip, greeting, refusal, uncertainty, injection and economic-ceiling tests. Extend them with
+small controlled scenario pairs; production inputs never contain desired actions or evaluation
+labels. Replays of model drafts test grounding/plumbing, not independent language understanding.
+
+| Requested behavior | Controlled local test / defensible acceptance |
+|---|---|
+| Legitimate cost pressure versus flexibility | Same buyer terms; vary reported pressure and separately corroborating applicable cost evidence. Supported pressure changes rationale/feasible exchange or clarification; flexibility supports an affordable price/term request. No invented discount, automatic concession or sustainable-margin hard floor |
+| Payment constraint changes concession structure | New separately identified synthetic fixture with payment and another approved negotiable lever; compare reported payment refusal with flexibility. Prefer the admissible other lever when justified; recompute complete costs. P10 payment stays fixed at 30 days/DAP; no P10 golden mutation |
+| Volume-dependent discount | Separate synthetic case with at least two volumes satisfying must-haves; preserve conditional supplier offer as reported evidence, evaluate its actual legal packages including uncovered need/commitment. Test a beneficial and a harmful trade. P10 only permits 23,400 after must-haves and cannot demonstrate a volume-choice flip |
+| Irrelevant wording | Greeting/paraphrase preserves semantic strategy and package/economics. Raw input and record hashes may change; do not demand identical provenance IDs |
+| Unsupported assertion | Claimed cost rise remains reported constraint/hypothesis with citations; unsupported or contradictory evidence cannot become canonical fact or outward verified claim. Missing/ambiguous approval yields unknown/clarify |
+| Strategy cannot bypass checks | Favor an over-ceiling candidate, invent an ID/edit a package, or recommend illegal/private output. Real evaluator and independent validator reject; executor receives no rejected action. Trace the rejection and admitted fallback/cannot-decide |
+
+Checkpoint B includes actual selected-action comparisons, not only intent-direction assertions.
+An appropriately unchanged action with a changed explanation is allowed where economics/legal
+constraints dominate; include controlled affordable scenarios where the action must change.
+Compare source revision → assessment category/citations → intent → candidate/economic delta →
+selection → validation in the trace. Test outcomes under a fixed clock/config; repeat locally
+without hosted calls. Add manifest entries only for the focused tests introduced for each slice.
+
+Keep three independent claims: **structural correctness** (schemas/ports/hashes), **behavioral
+correctness** (controlled relevant and irrelevant differences), **negotiation performance**
+(held-out independent outcomes, costs/regret/failures). A fake acknowledgement demonstrates
+neither persuasion nor savings. Later T3.4/T6 evaluations measure held-out model precision,
+grounding, unsupported assertions, latency and strategy outcomes under separately allowed usage.
+
+No gate machinery rewrite is needed. The existing `--v2-dto-require` accepts symbols and batches;
+`--v2-require` accepts selected module prefixes. Define each milestone's test selectors AND
+required symbol list. Run all contract tests for implemented symbols, not just happy-path examples.
+Missing required symbols/components fail; present malformed symbols, failed assertions and broken
+imports never xfail. List later unimplemented tests explicitly. The final full-contract gate stays
+`tests/v2 --v2-require all` (including optional/deferred exports); never use it to announce an
+intermediate capability complete. Run appropriate full repository checks before a future push,
+reporting inherited failures separately.
+
+## E. Precise proposed document amendments
+
+Apply these localized changes when adopting this proposal; they were **not applied in this pass**:
+
+1. **D-roadmap.md §1:** replace “Freeze shared models first” with “Freeze each implemented
+   boundary contract before its consumer; deliver dependency-complete DTO groups alongside
+   vertical component increments.” Add A–E crosswalk above; retain original M rows and evidence.
+   Change the diagram's whole-T1.1 arrows to consumed-contract prerequisites, not a new design.
+2. **task-specs.md T1.1d and batch graph:** retain D inventories and graph; remove the mandatory
+   global serial D1–D16 implementation barrier. Require topological symbol-level dependencies,
+   complete unions, serial shared-file ownership and documented handoffs. Batch completion
+   still requires every batch export. Change T1.2a/T1.4/T2.1/T4.1 dependencies to the exact
+   consumed-type closure. Split T1.2a P10 bindings from advanced scenario bindings, T5.1 used

+"""Pure source-layer resolution, before supplier/part/case applicability.
+
+Input records remain available to the caller as the shadowed revision archive.
+Temporal status is preserved; this increment does not derive freshness or truth.
+"""
+
+from ..core.models import Conflict, EvidenceRecord, Issue
+
+_PRIORITY = {"base": 0, "release": 1, "case": 2}
+_RULE = "base-release-case/1"
+
+
+def _issue(code, refs: tuple[str, ...], detail: str) -> Issue:
+    return Issue(code=code, severity="error", component="evidence.resolver", refs=refs, detail=detail)
+
+
+def _applicable(record: EvidenceRecord, case_id: str, suppliers: tuple[str, ...], parts: tuple[str, ...]) -> bool:
+    scope = record.scope
+    if scope.case_id is not None and scope.case_id != case_id:
+        return False
+    if scope.supplier_ids and not set(scope.supplier_ids).intersection(suppliers):
+        return False
+    if scope.part_ids and not set(scope.part_ids).intersection(parts):
+        return False
+    # Payload ownership cannot be broadened by an incomplete outer scope.
+    supplier = getattr(record.payload, "supplier", None)
+    part = getattr(record.payload, "part", None)
+    payload_parts = getattr(record.payload, "part_ids", ())
+    return not (
+        supplier is not None and supplier not in suppliers
+        or part is not None and part not in parts
+        or payload_parts and not set(payload_parts).intersection(parts)
+    )
+
+
+class LayeredEvidenceResolver:
+    def resolve(
+        self,
+        records: tuple[EvidenceRecord, ...],
+        *,
+        case_id: str,
+        supplier_ids: tuple[str, ...],
+        part_ids: tuple[str, ...],
+    ) -> tuple[tuple[EvidenceRecord, ...], tuple[Conflict, ...], tuple[Issue, ...]]:
+        """Return selected applicable revisions, resolution conflicts, and blocking issues.
+
+        Unsupported layers and conflicting record identities fail closed for affected
+        canonical groups. Unkeyed records resolve only by their own record identity.
+        An applicable lower version never revives an inapplicable higher version.
+        """
+        if not isinstance(records, tuple) or any(not isinstance(record, EvidenceRecord) for record in records):
+            raise TypeError("resolver inputs must be a tuple of validated EvidenceRecord objects")
+        for value in (supplier_ids, part_ids):
+            if not isinstance(value, tuple):
+                raise TypeError("target identifier collections must be tuples")
+        if any(not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip() or value != value.strip()
+               for value in (case_id, *supplier_ids, *part_ids)):
+            raise ValueError("target identifiers must be nonempty and unpadded")
+
+        by_id: dict[str, EvidenceRecord] = {}
+        damaged_ids: set[str] = set()
+        groups: dict[tuple[str, str], list[EvidenceRecord]] = {}
+        issues: list[Issue] = []
+        for record in records:
+            if record.record_id in by_id and by_id[record.record_id] != record:
+                damaged_ids.add(record.record_id)
+            by_id.setdefault(record.record_id, record)
+            key = ("canonical", record.canonical_id) if record.canonical_id is not None else (
+                "record", record.record_id,
+            )
+            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(record)
+        for record_id in sorted(damaged_ids):
+            issues.append(_issue("source_conflict", (record_id,), "Record identity has contradictory content."))
+
+        selected: list[EvidenceRecord] = []
+        conflicts: list[Conflict] = []
+        for (kind, identity), group in sorted(groups.items()):
+            if any(record.record_id in damaged_ids for record in group):
+                continue
+            unique = {record.record_id: record for record in group}
+            candidates = tuple(unique[key] for key in sorted(unique))
+            unsupported = tuple(record.record_id for record in candidates if record.provenance.layer not in _PRIORITY)
+            if unsupported:
+                issues.append(_issue("unsupported_capability", unsupported, "Source layer has no admitted priority."))
+                continue
+            priority = max(_PRIORITY[record.provenance.layer] for record in candidates)
+            top = tuple(record for record in candidates if _PRIORITY[record.provenance.layer] == priority)
+            if len(top) > 1:
+                refs = tuple(record.record_id for record in top)
+                conflicts.append(Conflict(canonical_id=identity, candidate_record_ids=refs,
+                                          rule_id=_RULE, blocking=True, reason_code="same_priority_collision"))
+                issues.append(_issue("source_conflict", refs, "Highest-priority source revisions disagree."))
+                continue
+            winner = top[0]
+            if kind == "canonical" and len(candidates) > 1:
+                conflicts.append(Conflict(canonical_id=identity,
+                                          candidate_record_ids=tuple(record.record_id for record in candidates),
+                                          winning_record_id=winner.record_id, rule_id=_RULE,
+                                          blocking=False, reason_code="layer_precedence"))
+            if not _applicable(winner, case_id, supplier_ids, part_ids):
+                issues.append(_issue("scope_mismatch", (winner.record_id,), "Selected revision is outside target scope."))
+                continue
+            selected.append(winner)
+
+        return tuple(selected), tuple(conflicts), tuple(issues)

+"""Internal evidence projections. They neither calculate official costs nor verify outward claims."""

+from ..core.errors import ContractViolation
+from ..core.models import CostFact, EvidenceContext, ResolvedCostInput, SourceRef
+from .resolver import LayeredEvidenceResolver
+
+
+class EvidenceProjections:
+    def cost_input(self, context: EvidenceContext, canonical_id: str) -> ResolvedCostInput:
+        """Project one admissible canonical cost revision, preserving its declared price basis.
+
+        Resolver issues are retained as context gaps; this initial consumer fails closed
+        on error gaps because their affected identity cannot always be recovered from
+        the selected records alone. No fallback to shadowed records or supplier reports.
+        """
+        if not isinstance(context, EvidenceContext):
+            raise TypeError("cost projection requires a validated EvidenceContext")
+        if not isinstance(canonical_id, str) or not canonical_id.strip() or canonical_id != canonical_id.strip():
+            raise ContractViolation("invalid_schema: canonical cost identifier must be nonempty and unpadded")
+        if any(issue.severity == "error" for issue in context.gaps):
+            raise ContractViolation("inadmissible_evidence: context has blocking resolution gaps")
+        matches = tuple(record for record in context.records if record.canonical_id == canonical_id)
+        if len(matches) != 1:
+            raise ContractViolation("missing_source: exactly one resolved cost revision is required")
+        record = matches[0]
+        for conflict in context.conflicts:
+            if conflict.canonical_id == canonical_id and (
+                conflict.blocking or conflict.winning_record_id != record.record_id
+            ):
+                raise ContractViolation("source_conflict: selected cost disagrees with source resolution")
+        selected, _, issues = LayeredEvidenceResolver().resolve(
+            (record,), case_id=context.case_id, supplier_ids=context.supplier_ids, part_ids=context.part_ids,
+        )
+        if issues or selected != (record,):
+            raise ContractViolation("scope_mismatch: cost source is outside the admitted scope or layers")
+        if record.kind != "canonical" or not isinstance(record.payload, CostFact):
+            raise ContractViolation("unsupported_claim: cost must be a canonical CostFact, not a supplier assertion")
+        temporal = record.temporal
+        if temporal.status != "current":
+            raise ContractViolation("inadmissible_evidence: cost freshness must be explicitly current")
+        as_of = context.as_of
+        if any(value is not None and value > as_of for value in (temporal.observed_at, temporal.published_at)):
+            raise ContractViolation("future_source: source observation or publication is in the future")
+        if temporal.data_as_of is not None and temporal.data_as_of > as_of.date():
+            raise ContractViolation("future_source: source data date is in the future")
+        if temporal.valid_from is not None and temporal.valid_from > as_of.date():
+            raise ContractViolation("future_source: cost source is not yet valid")
+        if temporal.valid_to is not None and temporal.valid_to < as_of.date():
+            raise ContractViolation("stale_source: cost source validity has expired")
+        price = record.payload.unit_cost
+        if price.basis.part_ids != (record.payload.part,) or record.scope.level == "basket":
+            raise ContractViolation("unknown_basis: part-specific cost requires an unambiguous single-part basis")
+        return ResolvedCostInput(
+            unit_cost=price, source_refs=(SourceRef(record_id=record.record_id, canonical_id=canonical_id),),
+            scope=record.scope, temporal=temporal,
+            issues=tuple(issue for issue in context.gaps if issue.severity == "warning"),
+        )

def binding(field, value):
    if field in {"unit_price", "tooling_eur", "chargeback_eur_per_complaint"}:
        value = str(value)
    if field == "index_clause" and value is not None:
        value = {**value, "material_share": str(value["material_share"]), "deadband_pct": str(value["deadband_pct"])}
    return dict(field=field, value=value)


def origin(field):
    return dict(field=field, source_kind="sheet", source_refs=[dict(record_id="source:terms")])


def resolved(values):
    raw = dict(bindings=[binding(k, v) for k, v in sorted(values.items())],
               origins=[origin(k) for k in sorted(values)], version_hash="a" * 64)
    model = ResolvedTerms.model_validate_json(json.dumps(raw))
    canonical = model.model_dump(mode="json")
    canonical.pop("version_hash")
    return changed(model, version_hash=semantic_hash(canonical))


def typed_case(raw, basis):
    seed = example("CaseContract")
    seed.update(case_id=raw["case_id"], case_type=raw["type"], title=raw["title"],
                supplier_ids=raw["suppliers"], parts=[dict(part_id=basis["part_ids"][0], price_basis=basis)],
                negotiable_fields=raw["negotiable"], options=[
                    dict(field=k, values=[binding(k, v)["value"] for v in values], allow_verified_standard=False)
                    for k, values in sorted(raw.get("term_options", {}).items())],
                fixed_terms=[binding(k, v) for k, v in sorted(raw.get("fixed_terms", {}).items())],
                round_limit=raw["round_limit"], case_facts=[], refs=[])
    b = raw["buyer"]
    seed["buyer"] = dict(
        category_goal=b["category_goal"], need_per_year=str(b["need_per_year"]), horizon_years=str(b["horizon_years"]),
        current_price=dict(amount=str(b["current_unit_price"]), basis=basis) if b.get("current_unit_price") else None,
        fallback_price=dict(amount=str(b["fallback_unit_price"]), basis=basis), interest_rate=str(b["interest_rate"]),
        reference_payment_days=b["reference_payment_days"], need_lead_time_days=b["need_lead_time_days"],
        fallback_risk_pct=str(b.get("fallback_risk_pct", 0)), index_risk_pct=str(b.get("index_risk_pct", 0)),
        late_cost_per_day=dict(amount=str(b.get("late_cost_per_day", 0))),
        cost_per_defect=dict(amount=str(b.get("cost_per_defect", 0))),

        relationship_eur_per_point=dict(amount=str(b["relationship_eur_per_point"]))
        if b.get("relationship_eur_per_point") is not None else None,
        freight=[dict(incoterm=k, eur_per_unit=str(v)) for k, v in b["freight_eur_per_unit"].items()],
        index_paths=[dict(series=k, delta_fraction=str(v)) for k, v in b.get("index_paths", {}).items()],
        must_haves=[{**m, "value": binding(m["field"], m["value"])["value"]} for m in b.get("must_haves", [])],
        alternative=dict(kind="unavailable", reason_code="offline-oracle-not-closing"),

"""Direct package comparisons without codec, strategy or runtime dependencies."""

from decimal import Decimal

import pytest
from arena_kit import cost as kit

from negotiator.v2.adapters.official import OfficialArithmetic
from negotiator.v2.core.errors import ContractViolation
from negotiator.v2.core.models import (

)
from negotiator.v2.economics.official import OfficialEconomicEvaluator, _version, economic_fingerprint

from .test_official_adapter import binding, estimate, p10_basis, typed_case
from .test_remaining_dtos import changed


def context_for(raw, basis, supplier=None, mode=None):
    case = typed_case(raw, basis)
    standards = supplier.standard if supplier else ResolvedStandards(bindings=(), field_origins=(), version_hash="0" * 64)
    standards = changed(standards, version_hash=_version(standards, "field_origins"))
    if supplier:
        supplier = changed(supplier, standard=standards)
    mode = mode or ("nominal_explicit" if supplier else "disabled_explicit")
    context = EconomicContext(
        case=case, standards_by_supplier=(SupplierStandards(supplier_id=case.supplier_ids[0], standards=standards),),
        estimates=(supplier,) if supplier else (),
        scenario_policy=ScenarioPolicy(mode=mode, scenarios=(EstimateScenario(
            scenario_id="explicit", estimate_ids=(supplier.estimate_id,),
        ),) if supplier else (), required_supplier_ids=case.supplier_ids if supplier else ()),
        cost_policy=CostPolicy(policy_id="test", comparison="robust_scenarios" if mode == "robust_scenarios" else "nominal",
                               price_bounds=PriceInterval(minimum=Price(amount=Decimal("0.01"), basis=case.parts[0].price_basis),
                                                          maximum=Price(amount=Decimal("100"), basis=case.parts[0].price_basis)),
                               tick=Decimal("0.01"), fallback_rule="preserve_baseline_if_feasible",
                               alternative_rule="compare_executable_else_no_deal_score"),
        fingerprint="0" * 64, issues=(),
    )
    return changed(context, fingerprint=economic_fingerprint(context))


def package(values, context):
    from negotiator.v2.core.models import TermBinding
    return Package(bindings=tuple(TermBinding.model_validate_json(__import__('json').dumps(binding(k, v)))
                                  for k, v in sorted(values.items())), price_basis=context.case.parts[0].price_basis)


def evaluate(p, c, oracle=None):
    return OfficialEconomicEvaluator(oracle=oracle or OfficialArithmetic()).evaluate_package(p, c.case.supplier_ids[0], c)


def test_two_legal_p10_packages_exact_complete_cost_comparison(p10):
    c = context_for(p10["case"], p10_basis(p10))
    results = []
    for golden in p10["official_cost_goldens"][:2]:
        values = {k: v for k, v in golden["terms"].items() if k in c.case.negotiable_fields}
        p = package(values, c)
        r = evaluate(p, c)
        assert r.must_haves_ok and r.numerically_valid and r.basis_verified
        assert r.nominal_cost.amount == Decimal(str(golden["total_cost"]))
        complete = kit.closing_terms(p10["case"], values)
        assert {x.kind: x.amount.amount for x in r.components} == {
            k: Decimal(str(v)) for k, v in kit.cost_breakdown(p10["case"], complete).items()
        }
        assert evaluate(p, c) == r
        assert any(o.source_kind == "fixed" for o in r.resolved_terms.origins)
        results.append(r)
    assert results[0].nominal_cost != results[1].nominal_cost
    assert results[0].economic_fingerprint != results[1].economic_fingerprint


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["nominal_explicit", "robust_scenarios"])
def test_explicit_scenario_parity_and_price_order_reversal(relationship, mode):
    raw, basis = relationship["case"], relationship["declared_fixture_basis"]
    e = estimate(relationship["estimate"], basis, raw["suppliers"][0])
    c = context_for(raw, basis, e, mode)
    results = []
    for price in (47, 49):
        values = {k: v for k, v in {**relationship["terms"], "unit_price": price}.items()
                  if k in c.case.negotiable_fields}
        r = evaluate(package(values, c), c)
        expected = kit.total_cost(raw, values, supplier=relationship["estimate"])
        assert r.nominal_cost.amount == Decimal(str(expected))
        assert r.scenario_costs[0].cost == r.nominal_cost
        assert r.scenario_costs[0].estimate_id == e.estimate_id
        assert r.assumption_refs == e.assumption_refs
        results.append(r)
    assert results[0].nominal_cost.amount > results[1].nominal_cost.amount


def test_missing_standards_and_incomplete_package_rejected(p10):
    c = context_for(p10["case"], p10_basis(p10))
    p = package({"unit_price": 28.34}, c)
    with pytest.raises(ContractViolation, match="incomplete"):
        evaluate(p, c)
    c = changed(c, standards_by_supplier=())
    c = changed(c, fingerprint=economic_fingerprint(c))
    with pytest.raises(ContractViolation, match="standards unavailable"):
        evaluate(p, c)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("field,value", [("payment_days", 90), ("lead_time_days", 54)])
def test_fixed_and_outside_option_values_are_not_repaired(p10, field, value):
    c = context_for(p10["case"], p10_basis(p10))

    values[field] = value

def test_incompatible_basis_rejected(p10):
    c = context_for(p10["case"], p10_basis(p10))
    p = package(p10["packages"][0], c)
    p = Package(bindings=p.bindings, price_basis=changed(p.price_basis, price_unit=100))

def test_oracle_numeric_failure_is_rejected_evaluation(p10):
    class Failing:
        def evaluate(self, case, terms, supplier):
            raise ContractViolation("component_rounding_mismatch: preserved official failure")
    c = context_for(p10["case"], p10_basis(p10))

    assert not r.components and not r.scenario_costs
    assert any(i.code == "nonfinite_cost" and "component_rounding_mismatch" in i.detail for i in r.issues)

    c = context_for(p10["case"], p10_basis(p10))

    with pytest.raises(ContractViolation, match="fingerprint"):
        evaluate(p, changed(c, fingerprint="b" * 64))

orchestration boundaries, dependency injection, strict contracts, deterministic finances,
independent validation, source applicability/provenance, reproducible records, and the pinned
official kit. Keep the existing serial coordinator and SQLite direction. Preserve V1 goldens
and audit obligations in A §4. The source inspected still contains the legacy inverse helper,
separate cost access, and mutable runtime paths; none becomes safe through this proposal.

The avoidable dependencies are **whole-task barriers**: T1.2a, T1.4, T2.1, and T4.1 name

"""Resolver-backed observations -> explicit estimates -> unchanged legal package comparisons."""

from decimal import Decimal

import pytest
from arena_kit import cost as kit

from negotiator.v2.core.errors import ContractViolation
from negotiator.v2.core.models import (
    EstimateRecord, EvidenceContext, FieldOrigin, NamedEstimate, Price, ResolvedStandards, SourceRef, TextRecord,
)
from negotiator.v2.core.serialization import semantic_hash
from negotiator.v2.economics.estimates import SourceCostEstimateBuilder
from negotiator.v2.economics.official import _version
from negotiator.v2.evidence.claims import EvidenceProjections
from negotiator.v2.evidence.resolver import LayeredEvidenceResolver

from .test_cost_projection import AS_OF, current
from .test_layered_resolver import changed
from .test_official_adapter import resolved
from .test_package_evaluation import context_for, evaluate, package


def source(relationship, amount, layer="release", revision=None):
    basis = context_for(relationship["case"], relationship["declared_fixture_basis"]).case.parts[0].price_basis
    r = current(layer, str(amount), supplier="sup:F", part=basis.part_ids[0], case="case:T01")
    r = changed(r, payload=changed(r.payload, unit_cost=Price(amount=Decimal(str(amount)), basis=basis)))
    return changed(r, record_id=revision or "sha256:" + semantic_hash(r))


def evidence(*sources):
    selected, conflicts, gaps = LayeredEvidenceResolver().resolve(
        tuple(sources), case_id="case:T01", supplier_ids=("sup:F",), part_ids=sources[0].scope.part_ids,
    )
    c = EvidenceContext(case_id="case:T01", supplier_ids=("sup:F",), part_ids=sources[0].scope.part_ids,
                        as_of=AS_OF, prepared_artifact_id="sha256:" + semantic_hash(sources),
                        records=selected, conflicts=conflicts, gaps=gaps, relevance=(),
                        source_versions=tuple(r.provenance.source_version for r in sources), context_version="pending")
    projection = c.model_dump(mode="json", exclude={"context_version"})
    return changed(c, context_version="sha256:" + semantic_hash(projection))


def standards():
    t = resolved({"payment_days": 60, "incoterm": "FCA"})
    std = ResolvedStandards(bindings=t.bindings, field_origins=tuple(
        FieldOrigin(field=b.field, source_kind="quote", source_refs=(SourceRef(record_id="quote:applicable-1"),))
        for b in t.bindings), version_hash="0" * 64)
    return changed(std, version_hash=_version(std, "field_origins"))


def assumption(cost, original):
    b = cost.unit_cost.basis
    values = tuple(NamedEstimate(name=name, value=value, unit=unit, basis=b if unit == "EUR_per_price_unit" else None,
                                 range_low=value if name == "full_cost" else None,
                                 range_high=value if name == "full_cost" else None)
                   for name, value, unit in (
                       ("full_cost", cost.unit_cost.amount, "EUR_per_price_unit"),
                       ("interest_rate", Decimal("0.08"), "fraction"),
                       ("usual_rate", Decimal("0.08"), "fraction"),
                       ("ppm", Decimal("0"), "ppm"),
                       ("extra_per_unit", Decimal("0"), "EUR_per_price_unit"),
                   ))
    r = changed(original, kind="hypothesis", canonical_id="assumption:source-cost",
                payload=EstimateRecord(kind="estimate", method_id="source-cost-v1", values=values,
                                       assumptions=cost.source_refs + (SourceRef(record_id="assumption:explicit-rates-zero-effects"),)))
    return changed(r, record_id="sha256:" + semantic_hash(r))


def construct(ctx, *, assumption_record=None):
    cost = EvidenceProjections().cost_input(ctx, "cost:310010")
    a = assumption_record or assumption(cost, ctx.records[0])
    estimate = SourceCostEstimateBuilder().construct(cost, supplier_id="sup:F", standard=standards(),
                                                    assumptions=a, as_of=AS_OF)
    return cost, a, estimate


def run(relationship, ctx):
    cost, a, estimate = construct(ctx)
    economic = context_for(relationship["case"], relationship["declared_fixture_basis"], estimate)
    packages = tuple(package({"unit_price": price, "payment_days": 60}, economic) for price in (45, 49))
    return cost, a, estimate, economic, packages, tuple(evaluate(p, economic) for p in packages)


def test_full_causal_chain_changes_economic_order_with_unchanged_packages(relationship):
    release = source(relationship, 43)
    override = source(relationship, 47, "case")
    first, second = run(relationship, evidence(release)), run(relationship, evidence(release, override))
    assert first[4] == second[4]
    assert first[0].unit_cost.amount == Decimal("43") and second[0].unit_cost.amount == Decimal("47")
    assert first[2].full_cost == first[0].unit_cost and second[2].full_cost == second[0].unit_cost
    assert first[2].estimate_id != second[2].estimate_id
    assert first[3].fingerprint != second[3].fingerprint
    for trace in (first, second):
        cost, a, estimate, economic, packages, results = trace
        assert cost.source_refs[0] in estimate.assumption_refs
        assert SourceRef(record_id=a.record_id, canonical_id=a.canonical_id) in estimate.assumption_refs
        assert estimate.uncertainty_kind == "unknown"
        assert estimate.standard == economic.standards_by_supplier[0].standards
        for p, r in zip(packages, results, strict=True):
            assert r.must_haves_ok and r.numerically_valid and r.basis_verified and not r.issues
            assert r.assumption_refs == estimate.assumption_refs
            raw_supplier = {**relationship["estimate"], "full_cost": float(cost.unit_cost.amount),
                            "usual_rate": 0.08, "ppm": 0, "extra": 0}
            values = {"unit_price": float(next(t.value for t in p.bindings if t.field == "unit_price")),
                      "payment_days": 60}
            assert r.nominal_cost.amount == Decimal(str(kit.total_cost(
                relationship["case"], values, supplier=raw_supplier,
            )))
        assert run(relationship, evidence(release) if cost.unit_cost.amount == 43 else evidence(release, override)) == trace
    assert [r.nominal_cost.amount for r in first[5]] == [Decimal("360000"), Decimal("392000")]
    assert [r.nominal_cost.amount for r in second[5]] == [Decimal("429044.44"), Decimal("401600")]
    assert first[5][0].nominal_cost.amount < first[5][1].nominal_cost.amount
    assert second[5][0].nominal_cost.amount > second[5][1].nominal_cost.amount


def test_disabled_estimates_keep_nominal_costs_unchanged(relationship):
    first = run(relationship, evidence(source(relationship, 43)))
    second = run(relationship, evidence(source(relationship, 47)))
    disabled = context_for(relationship["case"], relationship["declared_fixture_basis"])
    assert first[3].case.buyer == second[3].case.buyer == disabled.case.buyer
    assert first[4] == second[4]
    one = tuple(evaluate(p, disabled) for p in first[4])
    two = tuple(evaluate(p, disabled) for p in second[4])
    assert one == two
    assert [r.nominal_cost.amount for r in one] == [Decimal("360000"), Decimal("392000")]
    assert all(not r.assumption_refs and not r.scenario_costs for r in one)


def test_irrelevant_wording_does_not_change_estimates_or_economics(relationship):
    cost = source(relationship, 47)
    text = changed(cost, record_id="statement:greeting", canonical_id=None, kind="supplier_statement",
                   payload=TextRecord(kind="text", title="Greeting", text="Hello, thank you!", document_kind="message"))
    assert run(relationship, evidence(cost)) == run(relationship, evidence(cost, text))


def test_source_only_revision_changes_attribution_not_costs(relationship):
    a = source(relationship, 47)

    assert first[5][0].economic_fingerprint != second[5][0].economic_fingerprint


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["supplier_statement", "estimate", "hypothesis"])
def test_unverified_cost_claim_cannot_construct_estimate(relationship, kind):
    with pytest.raises(ContractViolation, match="unsupported_claim"):
        construct(evidence(changed(source(relationship, 47), kind=kind)))


def test_conflict_and_inapplicable_winner_block_construction(relationship):
    base = source(relationship, 43)
    one, two = source(relationship, 47, "case"), source(relationship, 48, "case")
    with pytest.raises(ContractViolation):
        construct(evidence(base, one, two))
    wrong = changed(one, scope=changed(one.scope, supplier_ids=("sup:OTHER",)))
    with pytest.raises(ContractViolation):
        construct(evidence(base, wrong))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("missing", ["full_cost", "interest_rate", "usual_rate", "ppm", "extra_per_unit"])
def test_missing_assumptions_do_not_become_defaults(relationship, missing):
    ctx = evidence(source(relationship, 47))
    cost = EvidenceProjections().cost_input(ctx, "cost:310010")
    a = assumption(cost, ctx.records[0])
    a = changed(a, payload=changed(a.payload, values=tuple(v for v in a.payload.values if v.name != missing)))
    with pytest.raises(ContractViolation, match="all five"):

    ctx = evidence(source(relationship, 47))
    cost = EvidenceProjections().cost_input(ctx, "cost:310010")

    with pytest.raises(ContractViolation, match="source_conflict"):

        construct(ctx, assumption_record=changed(a, payload=changed(a.payload,
                                                                 assumptions=(SourceRef(record_id="cost:old"),))))

    _, _, _, ctx, _, _ = run(relationship, evidence(source(relationship, 43)))

The full evidence-to-economics trace demonstrates a reversal with unchanged legal packages:

| Admitted cost estimate | €45 package | €49 package |
|---|---:|---:|
| €43 | **€369,600.00** | €401,600.00 |
| €47 | €429,044.44 | **€401,600.00** |

All components match the pinned kit. The reversal comes from its existing relationship penalty.

Explicit assumptions supply the full-cost mapping, bounds, rates, ppm and extra cost. Missing inputs fail; source and assumption revisions remain attributed.

Negative controls pass, including disabled estimates, irrelevant wording, unsupported claims, conflicts, scope/basis failures and illegal packages.

Verification: **25 direct tests passed; scoped V2: 727 passed, 603 explicit unfinished-work xfails**. Contract tests, Ruff and frozen V1 replay pass.

Limits remain: declared source metadata requires upstream verification; multiple-scenario nominal ambiguity is unchanged. No strategy or readiness claim.

[Trace, assumptions and verification details](/home/ugur/harve-y/tacto-negotiator/docs/v2/implementation-order-addendum-2026-10-10.md#k-t23-source-cost-estimate--t41-economics-verified-local-implementation).
